tests.title: Open 'Q3 Sales' from home and verify editor state matches seeded workbook; refresh direct URL restores same workbook
checks: Home page link has accessible name 'Q3 Sales' and shows 'Last updated: <value>'

Clicking link opens editor with workbook name 'Q3 Sales', same last-updated value, worksheet tabs/order, active Sheet1, row/column structure, grid values, formula bar, filters, validation entry points, and pivot results
Grid cell A1 is accessible as A1 and displays 'Region'; no data from another workbook appears
Refreshing the current editor page entry reloads exactly 'Q3 Sales' with Sheet1 active and A1=Region without navigating through home page

tests.title: In a later browser session visit the exact editor page entry for Q3 Sales; verify it restores Q3 Sales state and does not show another workbook's data
checks: Direct URL entry identifies the same workbook 'Q3 Sales' in a fresh/later session without home navigation
Active worksheet, tab order, and grid values (Sheet1, A1=Region) match the most recent successful state
Grid does not contain values from another workbook
No temporary blank page or different workbook is opened

tests.title: Create blank workbook via 'New blank workbook' and 'Create'; verify only blank Sheet1 active with A1 selected and state persists after refresh or reopen
checks: Home page has button with accessible name 'New blank workbook'
Creation page submit button is named 'Create'
After creation editor shows only a blank worksheet named Sheet1, active, with A1 selected
No other worksheet/data is present
Refreshing or returning home and reopening shows the same blank Sheet1 with A1 selected

tests.title: Rename open workbook to a trimmed non-empty name via 'Rename workbook'; verify editor title and home link update and persist after refresh/reopen
checks: Editor shows 'Rename workbook' button next to title
Dialog has text box 'Workbook name' prefilled with last saved name and a 'Save' button
After save, editor title and home-page link display the new name, with leading/trailing spaces trimmed
Reopening or refreshing shows the most recently saved name

tests.title: Attempt to save whitespace-only workbook name; verify 'Workbook name cannot be empty' and original name remains after refresh
checks: Entering only spaces in 'Workbook name' is rejected after trimming
Error 'Workbook name cannot be empty' is shown beside the control
Editor title and home-page link retain the original workbook name
No empty-name record persists after refresh

tests.title: Import UTF-8 CSV with Chinese, English, and numeric text and empty fields; verify new workbook named without .csv, Sheet1 populated in original order, and persistence
checks: Home page 'Import CSV' button opens dialog named 'Import CSV' with 'CSV file' control and 'Confirm import' button
Imported workbook name is the file name with final .csv removed
Sheet1 opens with complete rows/columns and original text, preserving empty fields and first row as ordinary data
Chinese text, English text, and numeric text are all present
After refresh/reopen grid content and row/column order remain unchanged

tests.title: Import CSV with quoted commas, escaped double quotes, and embedded line breaks; verify fields parsed correctly and persist
checks: Fields containing commas are kept intact inside quotes
Escaped pairs of double quotes are decoded correctly
Line breaks within quoted fields do not start new rows
Parsed grid matches original row/column order and persists after refresh/reopen

tests.title: Import CSV with empty fields; verify empty cells are preserved in exact row/column positions and first row remains ordinary data after reopen
checks: Empty fields are preserved as empty cells, not dropped
Row and column order exactly matches the CSV source
First row is ordinary data, not treated as a header
After refresh/reopen empty cells and order remain unchanged

tests.title: Import malformed CSV with unclosed double quote; verify rejection 'Invalid CSV file format. Import failed.', no workbook link, and no partial result retained
checks: Error 'Invalid CSV file format. Import failed.' is displayed
No workbook link with the attempted file name appears on the home page
No partial import result is displayed in the editor or retained after refresh
Original seeded state remains unchanged

tests.title: Click 'Export CSV' on editor toolbar; verify download ends .csv with current worksheet values and state unchanged after export/refresh
checks: Button with accessible name 'Export CSV' exists on editor toolbar
Clicking starts a download whose suggested filename ends with '.csv'
Downloaded UTF-8 text contains the active worksheet's values in actual row/column order
Active worksheet, filter view, grid values, and formula bar content remain unchanged before/after export and after refresh

tests.title: Export worksheet with empty cells in used range; verify CSV preserves empty fields in correct row/column order
checks: Empty cells within the used range are represented as empty fields in CSV
Row and column order of exported data matches the grid's actual order
No rows or columns are omitted because they contain blanks

tests.title: Export cells containing commas, double quotes, and line breaks; verify CSV escapes them according to CSV rules
checks: Text with commas is quoted in exported CSV
Double quotes are escaped as pairs of double quotes
Line breaks within fields are preserved inside quoted values
Exported CSV can be parsed back to the original cell values

tests.title: Export active worksheet Sheet1 with formula cells; verify CSV contains calculated results rather than formulas and grid/formula bar state persists unchanged
checks: Ordinary cells export their displayed values
Formula cells export current calculated results, not '=' expressions
After export, formula bar still shows original formula and grid shows same result
Active worksheet and worksheet state remain unchanged after refresh
